sentences.text:
======================================================
 MD. ZAKIR HUSSAIN Son of Md. Taslimuddin Resident of village -  Lachidaga, P.S. - Barsoi (Kachna OP), Distt. - Katihar  ... .
 Versus  THE STATE OF BIHAR
For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Akhauri Kamal Kishore Sahay, Advoc  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Anuj Kumar Shrivastava, APP

= ==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 18-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 406,
420, 384, 385 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
Petitioner is alleged to have taken money from the informant for providing a government job.
4. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that petitioner has falsely implicated in this case due to village politics.
As a matter of fact, informant tried to secure government job by illegal means which is itself an offence.

It is further submitted that with the intervention of well wishers a compromised petition has been filed in the court below which is duly signed by both the parties, as such the case has already Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.51379 of 2023(2) dt.18-08-2023 been compromised.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail petition of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, in the event of arrest or surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate , Katihar in connection with Abadpur P.S. case no 17 of 2023 Md. Zakir Hussain vs The State Of Bihar on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27943580/
1 , subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Kaushik/-
